text:
Predicates:
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Season(y) ::: y is a season.
Emma ::: Emma.
Mia ::: Mia.
James ::: James.
Spring ::: Spring.
Summer ::: Summer.
Fall ::: Fall.
Winter ::: Winter.

Premises:
FavoriteSeason(Emma, Summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(Mia, z) ∧ FavoriteSeason(Emma, Summer) ∧ ¬(z = Summer) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
WantVacation(James) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.

Conclusion:
∃z (Season(z) ∧ FavoriteSeason(Mia, z)) ∧ z = Spring ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
